digest.component_or_area: rebar duration probe and CLI tooling
propositions: Duration probe must remain read-only CLI/reporting layer while extracting reusable rollout/tracker parsing and statistical primitives into separate support module, both stdlib-only

Gated-close phase breakdown must distinguish direct metrics, direct event intervals, and inferred residuals with labeled output for pre-verifier, deterministic verifier, LLM verifier, and verdict-to-status stages
Probe must classify unmatched operations, no-LLM operations, forced/status/check/help, and interrupted operations as distinguishable from completed model-backed cohorts
CLI contract must support optional --current-since, --since, --until, --provider-prefix, and --log-root with documented defaults (~/.codex paths and .tickets-tracker)
Synthetic test suite with focused fixtures must validate command classification, terminal reconstruction, percentile calculation, and cohort filtering without import-time side effects
